method.method_draft: First read the diagram: P is above the straight base Q-S-R, with S between Q and R; segments PQ, PS, and PR are drawn, and the marked angle is ∠QPS. From the text, use Q,S,R collinear, ∠QPS=12°, and PQ=PS=RS. Since PQ=PS, triangle PQS is isosceles, so its base angles at Q and S are (180°−12°)/2=84°. Because QSR is a straight line, ∠PSR is the supplement of ∠QSP, so ∠PSR=96°. Since PS=RS, triangle PSR is isosceles with equal base angles at P and R, giving ∠SPR=(180°−96°)/2=42°. Finally, from the diagram ∠QPR is split by PS into ∠QPS+∠SPR, so ∠QPR=12°+42°=54°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: Q, S, R are collinear with R beyond S, and P is connected to Q and S with the 12° angle between PQ and PS; PR is the ray whose direction is sought. Use a coordinate/vector setup with the common length PQ=PS=RS scaled to 1. Put P at the origin and take ray PQ as the positive x-axis, so Q=(1,0) and S=(cos12°, sin12°). Because R lies beyond S on the line QS and RS=1, the vector from S to R is the unit vector in the direction from Q to S. Compute S−Q=(cos12°−1, sin12°), whose direction is 96° from the positive x-axis, so vector SR has length 1 and direction 96°. Therefore vector PR = vector PS + vector SR is the sum of two equal-length unit vectors with directions 12° and 96°. The resultant of two equal vectors points along the angle bisector of their directions, so PR has direction (12°+96°)/2=54° from PQ. Hence ∠QPR=54°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中，Q、S、R 位于同一条水平直线上，顺序为 Q 在左、S 在中间、R 在右；点 P 在这条直线的上方。图中画出了线段 PQ、PS、PR，并在 P 点处、PQ 与 PS 之间标出了 12° 的角。题目还给出 PQ = PS = RS。

推理：按指定方法建立坐标。令公共长度 PQ = PS = RS = 1，把 P 放在原点，并令射线 PQ 为正 x 轴，则 Q = (1, 0)。由于 ∠QPS = 12° 且 PS = 1，所以 S = (cos 12°, sin 12°)。

因为 Q、S、R 共线且 R 在 S 的外侧，所以从 S 到 R 的方向与从 Q 到 S 的方向相同。计算向量 S - Q = (cos 12° - 1, sin 12°)。利用恒等式 cos 12° - 1 = -2 sin²6°，sin 12° = 2 sin6° cos6°，可知该向量方向为 96°。又 RS = 1，所以向量 SR 是长度为 1、方向为 96° 的向量。

因此向量 PR = 向量 PS + 向量 SR，是两个等长单位向量的和，它们方向分别为 12° 和 96°。两个等长向量的合向量方向在二者方向角的角平分线上，所以 PR 的方向角为 (12° + 96°) / 2 = 54°。由于 PQ 是 0° 方向，所以 ∠QPR = 54°。
